description: Parameters every production caller hands an empty collection. Reported by core/verify/can_this_ever_fire.py. A reviewed entry carries the reason it is right; an unreviewed one is recorded so it is not lost, and counts as outstanding. Anything not listed here is a new finding and fails the gate.
non_claims: A listed entry is not approved by being listed. Only a reason approves it.
This finds a mechanism nobody can switch on. A gate nobody can fail is the same defect from the other side and needs the runtime, not this.

reviewed.core.connectome.gating:routing_change:ba: The empty baseline IS the comparison this caller wants: the ungated graph, so the report says how much the current state closes off. Reading it as 'no baseline' would be wrong — but it is passed explicitly rather than defaulted, which is why it reads as a switch and belongs on this list.
reviewed.core.conversational.humor_engine:observe: Deliberately empty at the only caller, with the reason written beside it: request context is user-controlled, and delivered-output classification must use the response itself unless a trusted generation caller invokes HumorEngine directly. The parameter exists for that trusted caller.
reviewed.core.interiority.ledger:practice:blocker: core/interiority/proving.py builds ledger fixtures for the proving harness, and a practice with no blockers is one of the states it is proving over. A fixture is entitled to be empty.
reviewed.core.learning.verified_token_trace:build: Same as encode_options: the identity is of the default decode path.
The bundle identity is over the DEFAULT encode path; options that change it would change the identity, which is the point. Empty is the identity being computed.
reviewed.core.learning.verified_transition_transa: The empty tuple IS the assertion this caller wants: staging a fresh transaction expects the event sequence to be exactly nothing, and None means no expectation at all. A populated tuple is the same check at a later stage and nothing needs it yet.
